commands.name: saver
commands.description: crew-chief token saver: on, off, or status (Opus subagents at medium effort)

commands.name: crew-compact
commands.description: crew-chief: propose a compaction now (updates the handoff files first)
commands.output: ok, I will ask when this turn ends.

commands.name: crew-tidy
commands.description: crew-chief: audit what fills your context (oversized, stale, repeated); "archive" moves old PROGRESS.md entries
commands.output:
Context audit (nothing was changed):
Nothing oversized, stale or repeated found in the files Claude loaded.

commands.name: crew-report
commands.description: crew-chief: tokens and cost by model and by main/subagent in this session
commands.output: No requests recorded in this session yet.

tools.name: crew_compact_checkpoint
tools.description: Propose compacting the conversation. Call it once, and only when a note from crew-chief says the context is large AND you have just finished a phase (a task done, tests passing, before an unrelated area). Never call it in the middle of work. It asks the user; if they decline, do not call it again.
